lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: PCIe Flex Bus eye / jitter
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Inherited PCIe 5.0 (CXL 1.x/2.0) or PCIe 6.0 PAM-4 (CXL 3.0) electrical compliance.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: CXL coherent access latency
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Measure added latency of CXL memory access vs local DRAM (typically ~200 ns).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Flit error / replay rate
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify Flit CRC + FEC keep the CXL.cache/CXL.mem link below target error rates.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Coherency protocol decode
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Protocol analyzer captures D2H/H2D + M2S/S2M channel messages for compliance.

notes: CXL inherits all PHY-level electrical calibration from the underlying PCIe base spec (PCIe 5.0 or 6.0). The CXL-specific lab metric is coherent-access latency (CXL memory controllers add about 200 ns); protocol-level compliance is decoded with CXL-aware analyzers per the CXL Consortium Compliance program.
